name: REPLACE-provider-name
notes: Filled from <provider docs URL> on <date>. Only field names/values that appear in the provider's own docs.

model_map.gpt-image-2.6-sunburst: REPLACE provider's id for this model (may be a path segment)
REPLACE provider's id/endpoint of the EDIT variant if it differs (e.g. '.../sunburst/edit' or '...-image-to-image')

_reference.param spec forms: "field" | {"to": "a.b", "transform": T, "map": {canonicalValue: providerValue}, "choices": [...], "tiers": {...}, "single": true} | list of these (one canonical -> several provider fields)
_reference.transforms: aspect_ratio (WxH -> 'w:h' or nearest of choices) | resolution_tier (WxH -> 1K/2K/4K by megapixels, override with tiers) | width | height | int | float | bool | list | first | data_uri | b64 | file (multipart upload) | template ({value})
_reference.omit a canonical param: remove it from params; runner warns and does not send it. If 'n' is unmapped the runner loops calls. If 'negative_prompt' is unmapped it is appended to the prompt as 'Avoid: ...'.
_reference.url instead of path: set operations.X.url to a full URL (supports {model} and ${ENV})
_reference.edit model: Many providers expose the edit variant under a different id/endpoint. Put it in operations.edit.model_map; operation-level model_map wins over the global one.

models: optional: canonical ids this provider serves (alternative to model_map)

list_models._optional: only if the provider has a model-listing endpoint
